content: In the Transformer, the encoder is composed of a stack of N identical layers and each layer has one multi-head self-attention layer and one position-wise fully connected feed-forward layer. One residual connection is around two sub-layers and followed by layer normalization BIBREF24. This architecture provides the Transformer a good ability to generate representation of sentence.
